title: Operator asks about Tripworks mid-intake
persona: Priya Nair, ops manager at a Chicago black car service. Fast, clipped, businesslike.
goal: Ask about Tripworks compatibility while booking a point to point demo ride.
opening_line: Hi, I need a car Thursday night, point to point. Also we use Tripworks, does this connect?

turns.caller: Going to the Palmer House hotel in Chicago.
Wait, back to Tripworks. Can it push reservations into it?

branches.caller: Okay, have somebody call me about that then.

turns.caller: Vehicle, an SUV I guess. Black one.
So what's next, who calls me?

curveballs: Asks for follow up by a person
Opens with two requests at once
expected: Handles both the trip request and the software question without losing intake
Routes the callback request to the team
Confirms pickup, drop-off, time and passengers captured
must_not: Name a specific person or owner
Ask for pickup address again after it was given
